name: Casio PV-1000
description: Casio's only cartridge console before the Loopy, released in Japan in October 1983 for 14,800 yen. Facing the Famicom and SG-1000, it disappeared within about a year after only 13 games.
curiosities: Only 13 games were released, including Konami ports such as Tutankham, Super Cobra and Pooyan.
Two cartridge numbers, GPA-108 and GPA-113, were never released.
Its successor on the console side was the Casio Loopy of 1995.
It came out in Japan in 1983, the same year as the Famicom and the SG-1000.
story: Casio released the PV-1000 in Japan in 1983, its only games console.
It sold poorly against the Famicom and was withdrawn quickly.
It is now a rare collector's item.
